create_vasp_static_inputs: create VASP input files for an OMat24 PBE static calculation using OMat24StaticSet with a pymatgen Structure
create_vasp_relax_inputs: create VASP input files for an OMat24 PBE relaxation calculation using OMat24RelaxSet with a pymatgen Structure
create_vasp_aimd_inputs: create VASP input files for an OMat24 AIMD calculation using OMat24AIMDSet with temperature and thermostat settings
review_aimd_incar_updates: review the OMat24AIMDSet incar_updates property to see INCAR parameters for NVT or NPT ensemble configurations
review_relax_incar_updates: review the OMat24RelaxSet incar_updates property to see IBRION NSW and ISIF relaxation parameters
